fato_historico: 1830: July Revolution: Charles X of France abdicates the throne in favor of his grandson Henri.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to embrace a profound transformation. Much like a grand change in leadership, you may find it is a good time to abdicate outdated habits that no longer serve your spirit. Consider this an auspicious moment to crown your authentic self and step into the power you have been carefully cultivating within your depths.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the grace of letting go and rising anew.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of power and eternal personal cycles.
conselho: Release old burdens and trust the wisdom of your inner transition today.
